content.short: AhoraCrypto is a MiCA-licensed non-custodial onramp for buying 70+ cryptocurrencies.
content.description: AhoraCrypto sells more than seventy cryptocurrencies directly into a buyer's own wallet and holds no customer balances. The service is MiCA licensed and authorized by Spain's CNMV, which lets it operate across the European Union. A purchase settles on-chain in under two minutes, and AhoraCrypto puts its user count above seven thousand.
content.meta: Buy 70+ cryptocurrencies straight to your own wallet through a MiCA-licensed European onramp.
